{{Quote|We were sitting ducks out there! A quarter of my men were killed and all because of defective weapons!|Dealk|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Dealk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] in [[3642 BBY]], he led a group of soldiers to retake the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] from the Empire. Unfortunately, the soldiers were unaware of the [[Neutralizer (device)|Neutralizer]], a prototype Imperial weapon that disabled standard Republic weaponry. Left defenseless, Dealk lost a quarter of his men before being forced to retreat to [[Upper Sundari Outpost]].
